items.title: Russia summons Estonian diplomat over planned border closure
items.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry summoned Estonia's acting chargé d'affaires to protest Tallinn's decision to close border checkpoints. Moscow called the move confrontational and warned that attempts to isolate Russia would carry serious economic and social consequences for Estonia.

items.title: Russia responds after Austria alleges damage to its Kyiv diplomatic mission
items.summary: Russia's embassy said it had repeatedly warned foreign diplomats, including Austrians, about the dangers of remaining in Ukraine and placed responsibility for potential consequences on Vienna. Austrian leaders had earlier accused Russia of striking their diplomatic mission's building in Kyiv.

items.title: Russian military claims drone strikes on Ukrainian supply vehicles in Zaporizhzhia
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said drones operated by Novorossiysk airborne troops struck ground robotic supply vehicles carrying fuel, ammunition and food, as well as infantry pickup trucks, in Zaporizhzhia region. The ministry did not specify the number of vehicles destroyed.
